related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.
related_work.campaign_objective: Make environmental services accountable through evidence from real MNCS development, and make machine-native work easier to discover and carry out.

measurement_basis: Explicit link from the observed ECI compaction pressure to the committed Environment implementation, regression verification, and same-session post-change readback. Integration-time verification and longer-term service effectiveness remain separate.
not_measured: whether other agents discover or interpret the summary reliably
whether the change reduced agent intervention in ordinary workflows
whether the pressure recurs across sessions or has been eliminated long term
whether any binding was needed by the selected work intent
whether the implementation changes native-versus-host ownership or migration readiness

outcome.implementation_change: The bounded ECI response now retains observed_use_accountability beside availability when it compacts per-binding details. It preserves only exact provider, binding ID, and contract-revision invocation counts, completion and outcome counts, bounded source events, and selected-window completeness.
outcome.verified_change: The full capability-intelligence regression module passed all 194 tests. A same-session post-change ECI readback returned the new use summary within the 73,728-byte CLI response limit and preserved the truncated-window and unestablished-agent states.
outcome.interpretation_limit: This verifies evidence preservation and compaction behavior. It does not establish agent receipt, discoverability, reduced intervention, or long-term resolution of the pressure.

improvement_relation.basis: The evidence-priority summary now carries exact interaction counts and references from the existing binding-evidence summary while preserving availability, event-window limits, and explicit uncertainty about agent attribution and receipt.
not_measured: agent-reported or independently observed intervention reduction
cross-session recurrence or long-term pressure resolution
whether the additional evidence enables a new native implementation
whether a capability was needed or successfully used by an agent
